description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseAttributeType' within the OpenMRS project. The class serves as a base implementation for attribute types, providing common properties and getters/setters such as minOccurs, maxOccurs, datatypeClassname, datatypeConfig, preferredHandlerClassname, and handlerConfig. It is designed to be extended by specific attribute type implementations like VisitAttributeType or ProviderAttributeType.

classes.name: BaseAttributeType
classes.description: An abstract base class for attribute types in OpenMRS, providing common properties related to attribute data types and occurrence constraints, intended for extension by specific attribute type classes.
